n76e3213a72.headline: World bank facility  unlocks key imports
n76e3213a72.summary: The Reserve Bank of Malawi says local banks can now secure letters of credit for importing strategic commodities. The support comes through a World Bank Investment Project Financing facility amid economic crisis.

n3eab2e0f34.summary: Labour Day traffic showed how travel times could be reduced with the new Northland Expressway corridor, valued at $18 billion.
n3eab2e0f34.why: Large transport infrastructure projects like this one affect construction spending, regional growth and the contractors bidding for public works.

n6b42ede60d.headline: Trump lowers China's tariffs. And, what to know for Casey Means' confirmation hearing
n6b42ede60d.summary: President Trump met Chinese President Xi Jinping to address trade tensions and lowered China's tariffs. The move follows a period of US-China trade friction.
n6b42ede60d.why: US-China tariffs affect global supply chains, import costs, and the earnings of exporters and multinationals on both sides.

n0646ab7929.headline: Ofori-Atta approved payments to SML without technical basis – OSP
n0646ab7929.summary: Ghana's Office of the Special Prosecutor accused former Finance Minister Ken Ofori-Atta of approving payments to Strategic Mobilisation Ghana Limited without technical or operational justification.
n0646ab7929.why: Allegations involving public-sector payments affect fiscal accountability, investor confidence in Ghana's public finances, and its debt negotiations.

naaf176175e.headline: Wood Group reports decline in first-half profit
naaf176175e.summary: Wood Group reported a drop in first-half profit on Thursday, ahead of its conditional takeover by Sidara. Sharecast reported the results.
naaf176175e.why: Wood Group is a UK-listed engineering and consultancy firm serving the energy sector, and its pending takeover makes its results relevant to shareholders.

n5dfcfe8478.headline: Swiggy's net loss widens to Rs 1,092 crore in Q2
n5dfcfe8478.summary: Swiggy reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 1,092 crore for the quarter ended September, as the food delivery and quick commerce platform posted results.
n5dfcfe8478.why: Swiggy is an Indian food delivery and quick commerce platform, and its losses reflect the cash burn of rapid expansion in the sector.

n044a2fa9bc.headline: Reeves need not resign after admitting rental rule break, minister insists
n044a2fa9bc.summary: The Prime Minister said it was 'not necessary' to launch a probe into Chancellor Rachel Reeves's admitted breach of a rental rule.
n044a2fa9bc.why: The Chancellor of the Exchequer sets UK fiscal policy and budgets, so leadership stability in the post affects gilt markets and investor confidence.

n488d18d40f.headline: Indians In Malaysia Can Now Pay With UPI: India’s Payment Apps Just Went Global For Travelers
n488d18d40f.summary: Indian travellers will be able to pay merchants in Malaysia by scanning QR codes with Indian UPI apps. The rollout follows Razorpay's entry into Malaysia through Curlec.
n488d18d40f.why: Razorpay is an Indian payments company, and UPI is India's national real-time payment system. Cross-border expansion of payment rails widens fintech revenue opportunities.

n743c2ba2f1.headline: With inflation under control, ECB holds rates steady again - Latest News
n743c2ba2f1.summary: The European Central Bank kept interest rates unchanged on Thursday, warning of an uncertain economic outlook amid trade disputes and geopolitical tensions.
n743c2ba2f1.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, and its rate decisions shape borrowing costs and the value of the euro.

n8e5dde6698.headline: Virgin hopes to run direct trains from London to Paris Charles de Gaulle airport
n8e5dde6698.summary: Richard Branson said Virgin has overcome a key hurdle to begin running international train services from London to Paris Charles de Gaulle airport. The service is being planned, not yet running.
n8e5dde6698.why: Virgin is a British conglomerate whose rail ventures compete with incumbent Eurostar on the London to Paris corridor.

nd29355deb3.headline: Nevada’s long history of nuclear training as President Trump reinstitutes testing
nd29355deb3.summary: President Trump ordered the Pentagon to resume nuclear testing immediately, ending a moratorium in place since 1992. The order marks a major shift in US nuclear policy.

n605dff2189.summary: The Office of Rail and Road has granted Virgin access to share Eurostar's depot in east London. The move opens the way for Virgin to challenge Eurostar's Channel Tunnel services.
n605dff2189.why: Eurostar is the main operator of passenger trains through the Channel Tunnel, and access rules shape competition on the London-Paris-Brussels routes.

ne2aa53692f.headline: Fed Divisions Reveal New Caution Over Continued Cuts
ne2aa53692f.summary: The Federal Reserve cut rates at its second consecutive meeting, but Chair Jerome Powell cast doubt on expectations for more cuts. Officials were divided.

ne9bb209482.headline: Australia news: ANZ flag AUD1.1bn hit to second-half profit from restructuring, settlement
